Presence of holes in base plate to be checked before installation for each equipment's

points.point: Earthing of mounting stand & ACCB earthing
points.norm: Earthing to be done as per manufacturer manual / drawing

points.point: Ground clearance of the ACCB after fixing.
points.norm: As per drawing
Size should be as per drawing and should be tighten rigidly
Lug size should be as per drawing/specs. and crimping should be rigid and adequate
As per manufacturer manual / IS codes and marking to be done with permanent marker

points.point: Use of heat shrinkable sleeve to the terminated cables.
points.norm: Should be as per required color code and free from burn marks and distortion, need to apply suitably ACCB Installation

points.point: Dressing & straightness of the terminated cables.
points.norm: Cables should be straight and dressed with neatness & securely, Cable straight and dressing to be checked before trench backfilling
As per drawing / SLD / Specs.
